This dashboard provides a high-level view of your VMware vSphere environment, with in-depth resource utilization metrics from your hosts and VMs, along with the status of your vCenter Server. For further reading on monitoring vSphere: 

- [How to monitor vSphere and application metrics with Datadog](https://www.datadoghq.com/blog/unified-vsphere-app-monitoring-datadog/)

Clone this template dashboard to make changes and add your own graph widgets.
title: VMware vSphere - Overview

definition.content:
**vSphere**

This dashboard provides a high-level view of your VMware vSphere environment, with in-depth resource utilization metrics from your hosts and VMs, along with the status of your vCenter Server.

**Useful Links**

- [How to monitor vSphere and application metrics with Datadog](https://www.datadoghq.com/blog/unified-vsphere-app-monitoring-datadog/) 

- [Datadog's vSphere integration docs](https://docs.datadoghq.com/integrations/vsphere/#pagetitle). 

- [vSphere docs](https://www.vmware.com/products/cloud-infrastructure/vsphere)
